ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (dark grey to black) with localized high-intensity clusters (white) representing less than 10% of total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity pigmentation across the visible ventral plane; high-contrast white clusters localized at the distal lobe tips and scattered fine-line linear white markers across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a visible depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1 at the central junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys across the entire visible trailing edge, exhibiting significant jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharper upward taper toward the heavily encrusted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of roughly circular white high-intensity pixel groups localized at the superior-most tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, fine vertical and diagonal white linear marks distributed across the dark ventral surface, appearing as high-frequency noise against the low-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) at the lobe extremities and a significantly irregular, potentially traumatized trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: White hydraulic spray and foam occlude the basal center and lower-right regions of the fluke structure.
